title: Hiring Toni, his first wife, as band singer
summary: He tells how he met Toni, who had come to Hawaii to sing with Eddie Sereno's band.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: And it was Jazz? Right? You played Jazz.
It was Jazz, yeah. And I had hired Toni (that's my first wife) to sing with the band. So that's how that all happened.
Oh, she was living in Hawaii.

She was living there. She had gone over to sing with a band, Eddie Sereno's band. Eddie Sereno's wife, Marge, had been singing in his band, she became pregnant and couldn't sing, so they sent for Toni -- and that's how I met Toni. And I hired her to sing in my band.
